art.enemyPrompt: A full-body chibi sticker of a small monkey with a round chestnut-brown head, a peach oval face, two round ears with peach insides, a short tan-brown body, and a curled brown tail. It stands on a flat magenta background with a thick dark outline, no clothes, and no text.
art.bossPrompt: A full-body chibi sticker of the minor leader of the monkey troop, with the same monkey parts: a round chestnut-brown head, a peach oval face, two round ears with peach insides, a short tan-brown body, and a curled brown tail. He stands on a flat magenta background with a thick dark outline and no text, and he is not dressed as Sun Wukong, so he has no golden headband, staff, tiger-skin skirt, armor, or crown.
art.backdropPrompt: A wide 16:9 children's storybook landscape of Flower-Fruit Mountain for The Monkey: a bright daytime sky with soft clouds, green slopes of peach-blossom trees and ripe peaches, a distant waterfall, and warm grassy ground. A clear empty dirt path runs through the center, open and unoccupied. No characters, no animals, no letters, and no writing.
